_comment: Source for iOSClient/Settings/Acknowledgements.rtf (Settings > Information > Acknowledgements). tools/rebrand.py writes the RTF from this file. Plain text only: names, licences, copyright lines. No logos, no links to nextcloud.com. Licence ids read with `gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>/license` on 2026-10-25; copyright lines from each project's LICENSE file (Apache-2.0 projects: holder named in the project's source headers). Update this list when Package.resolved changes. Not legal advice.
